labs.title: Lab 1: Intro DC Circuits & Voltage Divider
labs.summary: Build a current-limited LED indicator and a 2.5 V resistive divider, then verify with the DMM.

labs.title: Lab 2: Analog RC Low-Pass Filter & Bode Plot
labs.summary: Build a 1.59 kHz RC low-pass filter on NI ELVIS II and measure its cutoff on Bode & Scope.

labs.title: Lab 3: Optical Finger PPG (LED + Photoresistor)
labs.summary: Pair a lit Red LED with a photoresistor in Finger PPG mode and plot the pulse on Arduino Nano.

labs.title: Lab 4: Safe Isolated Surface EMG (IEC 60601 + FIR)
labs.summary: Build a single-supply AD620 EMG front end with ADuM3160 USB isolation, HPF DC blocking, and FIR DSP.
